title: Has anyone been to the large green warehouse that I call purgatory?
content: Inside the warehouse there are separate sections with people doing things that they were probably used to in their life. First instance, I saw a room with conveyor belts and people working. As if it’s all they knew in life. Another part was a dark night club were people partied. Another part was athletes getting ready for some sort of event. All within a city with a few pyramids at the center.
